analysis.primary_selection: All65 previously frozen known expert open events>=2, all18 models and all3 saved conditions, no outcome/seed selection.
analysis.segment: From expert action event e inclusive (lag0) until first same-demo action with gripper>=0 exclusive or last cached action inclusive. Contiguous IDs from1 required; never infer action0. Record expert_command_change versus demo_end.
analysis.error: Expert-open frame is correct only when predicted_g<0; exactly0 is a neutral error distinct from positive wrong-close. No epsilon or margin threshold.
analysis.recovery: Record first correct lag, last wrong lag, negative tail start after last wrong, wrong fraction, initial wrong length, wrong runs and reentry after first correct. No correct before command/demo end => null recovery with censor flag, never fill0 or average only recovered without reporting denominator.
analysis.landmark_denominator: At each lag eligible segments still in the same expert-open command only. Report eligible count, wrong and first-correct-seen counts; do not fill unavailable frames or compare unpaired subsets.
analysis.secondary_initial_prefix: For every source demo, record observed initial expert-open prefix from cachedt1 if target is negative; start unknown/left-censored, not a synthetic event at1. Identity only, all demos/empty prefixes preserved. Contrast is descriptive and context-confounded.
analysis.saved_intervention_scope: Existing replacements remain restricted to original306 frames. Require bitwise equality outside original selection and at eventlag0 across full source frames. Extending analysis never extends the intervention.
analysis.prior_harmed_followup: Retain all17 primary and5 secondary old harmed model-frames exactly. Inspect immediate original wrong neighbors in full command and classify bridge/extend previous/advance next/isolated, with boundary-observed flags; report containing changed-error run and original components. No newly selected trials.
analysis.summaries: Every segment, per-model/task-arm/task, per-demo/equal-demo, all seed comparisons B-A/B-C, first-response and reentry separately, phase-end censoring, unique source versus model-event counts. No pooled-task success or significance.
analysis.training_decision: Keep500/stabilization5/currentloss and all old branch stops. This analysis alone does not authorize model acceptance or training change.

failure_rule: Fail closed on hash, role, matrix, dtype/shape/finite, source ordering, event identity, intervention outside selection, old harmed count or command-boundary mismatch; preserve prior artifacts.
